title: Cars First
can_do: 面对两个都要完成的任务时，提出一个可行顺序。
trigger: Dad asks for the cars and blocks to be put away before they make pancakes together.
core_response: What if we put away the cars first?
stretch_response: What if we do the cars first, then the blocks?
repair_response: I mean cars first, not pancakes first.
setting: Cleaning the play area before a shared activity.

turns.speaker: dad
turns.line: Please put the toys away before we make pancakes.

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: What if we put away the cars first?

turns.speaker: dad
turns.line: That can work. Then the blocks need a home too.

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: Cars first, then blocks, then pancakes?

turns.speaker: dad
turns.line: That order works. I will take the blocks.

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: I will take the cars. Let us start.

replay_cards.title: Coats and shoes
replay_cards.change: Both coat and shoes are needed
replay_cards.challenge: Propose shoes first, then coat; Dad agrees and both steps are completed

replay_cards.title: Books and animals
replay_cards.change: Two groups belong in different places
replay_cards.challenge: Propose books first and stuffed animals second; Mom takes one group and the child takes the other

parent_support: Keep the real boundary: both jobs still happen before pancakes.
Accept any safe order and join the action after agreeing.
